content.short: Manta Network is a modular ZK ecosystem featuring Manta Pacific (L2 on Ethereum) and Manta Atlantic (L1 Polkadot).
content.description: Manta Network is a leading modular ecosystem designed for the next generation of Zero-Knowledge (ZK) applications. It consists of two primary networks: Manta Pacific, a modular Layer 2 on Ethereum that uses Celestia for data availability, and Manta Atlantic, a high-speed ZK-focused Layer 1 on Polkadot. This dual structure allows developers to deploy ZK-enabled dApps with high throughput and significantly lower gas fees compared to traditional environments. By leveraging advanced ZK-proofs, Manta Network provides a secure and privacy-preserving framework for DeFi, gaming, and identity applications.
content.meta: Manta Network provides modular ZK-enabled Layer 1 and Layer 2 infrastructure for decentralized apps. Discover more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
